उज्झ r. 6th cl. (उज्झति) To quit or abandon. This is sometimes read
उद्झ. With प्र, to escape or avoid.

उज्झ m. (-ज्झः) Abandoning, leaving.
 E. उज्झ and क aff.

उज्झित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Left, abandoned.
 2. Left off, discontinued. E.
उज्झ to leave, affix क्त.

उज्झितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what leaves.
 E. उज्झ and तृच् aff.
